title: HIV: Z21, B20 or R75
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's HIV status (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for AIDS management.

HPI
Pt is an 80-year-old female presenting for routine follow-up of AIDS. She reports she has been feeling well overall since last visit. Denies any acute respiratory symptoms, fever, chills, or new-onset fatigue. She continues to adhere to her prescribed antiretroviral therapy. No new opportunistic infection noted today. Pt reports good compliance with medication regimen and stable energy levels.

Medication List
- Antiretroviral therapy (ART) regimen
- Multivitamin daily
- Calcium with Vitamin D

Review of Systems
Constitutional: No fever, chills, or night sweats.
Respiratory: No cough or shortness of breath.
GI: No nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.
MSK: No joint pain or swelling.
Neuro: No headaches or dizziness.

Social History
Pt lives at home with her daughter. Retired. Non-smoker. Occasional social alcohol use.

Family History
Mother: Hypertension, Stroke.
Father: Type 2 Diabetes.
Siblings: No known chronic conditions.

Vitals
BP: 128/78
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 98% on RA
Weight: 145 lbs

Recent Labs
CD4 count: 450 cells/mm3
Viral load: Undetectable
eGFR: 65
HbA1c: 5.8%

Exam
General: Alert and oriented x3. Appears well-nourished and in no acute distress.
Skin: No new rashes or lesions noted.
HEENT: Mucous membranes moist. No oral lesions.
Respiratory: CTAB. No wheezes or crackles.
Cardiac: RRR, no murmurs.
Musculoskeletal: No edema.
Neurological: Alert, steady gait, no tremors.

Assessment
1. AIDS: Stable on current antiretroviral therapy. No new opportunistic infection today.

Plan
1. Continue current ART regimen as prescribed.
2. Routine labs to be repeated in 3 months.
3. Patient instructed to report any new symptoms immediately.
4. Follow up in 3 months.

Electronically signed, T. Haddad, NP, 05/14/2026
